source.title: Red = Dead
source.description:
It seems that the beast that attacked light's hope is Caldoran's pet and the attack on Light's Hope was merely a ruse to draw our forces out and commit us to this attack. Caldoran and Beatrix sought to use us to create a distraction and remove a rival in Balnazzar, and then turn on us and remove us as a presence in the Plaguelands after they regained control.

We don't have all of the answers and it's looking grim, but we will put these dogs down for this treachery.
source.progress: What in the light's name has the Scarlet Crusade been doing behind these walls?
source.completion:
What we've discovered here is beyond the pale. A new plague? A lightbound dragon? Siphoning the souls of the pious to fuel their light-infused weapons? Such abuse of the light is sickening, and I shudder to think what other power Caldoran may yet have at his disposal. The way he destroyed Balnazzar tells me that he's been up to something. Such raw power is beyond even the strongest of paladins.

All the same, it ends now. No quarter will be given. These atrocities are beyond redemption.
